subject.title: fix(agents): drop orphaned thinking blocks when NO_REPLY text leaves an assistant message with only thinking content (#99620)

question: Should silent-reply normalization globally delete an assistant turn that becomes thinking-only for every provider, or should this cleanup be limited to Anthropic-family replay policy?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but it converts an Anthropic-observed failure into a permanent generic transcript-deletion invariant that provider hooks cannot override.

options.title: Accept the generic invariant
options.body: Treat thinking-only residue from a silent reply as universally non-replayable and land the tested current head.

options.title: Scope by provider
options.body: Move the deletion into Anthropic-compatible replay policy so other providers retain their existing generic replay behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic invariant
recommendation.body: Treat thinking-only residue from a silent reply as universally non-replayable and land the tested current head.

likelyOwner.reason: This person landed adjacent replay sanitation and is the explicit decision recipient in the PR discussion.
